map.域名生成器是一款IT 开发领域的在线工具。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，: Domain Name Generator is an online tool in the IT development category. Built for developers, it runs entirely in the front end and your code never leaves the browser.

map.本工具按「前缀 + 主体 + 可选后缀」的词库组合批量生成候选域名，并过滤掉超长: This tool batch-generates candidate domains by combining a "prefix + stem + optional suffix" word list, filtering out combinations that are too long (a single label over 63 characters) or contain illegal characters (only letters, digits and hyphens are allowed, and a hyphen may not start or end a label). To be clear: the page only performs string combination and filtering locally in the browser and cannot tell whether a domain is already registered — real availability must be confirmed with a registrar or a WHOIS/DNS lookup. When choosing, favour short, easy-to-spell, easy-to-say combinations and avoid spellings close to an existing trademark.

map.能查是否注册吗？: Can it check whether a domain is registered?

map.生成结果需要再校验什么？: What else should I verify about the results?
map.至少三步：一是到注册商查是否被注册及价格；二是检索是否与已有商标或知名品牌近似，: At least three steps: check with a registrar whether the name is taken and what it costs; search for similarity to existing trademarks or well-known brands to avoid infringement and phishing suspicion; and check how the name fares on social media and in search engines. Note also that hyphens and digits cut into word-of-mouth transmission sharply, so an important brand should avoid them.
